titulo.alumno:
«Нереальное условие в прошлом»
Unreal condition in the past

intro: Если бы + past tense presents a condition that did not happen; то + бы expresses the hypothetical result.

frases.estudio: Если бы редактор заметил ошибку, статью бы исправили раньше.
frases.alumno: If the editor had noticed the mistake, they would have corrected the article sooner.

frases.estudio: При другой погоде экспедиция состоялась бы.
frases.alumno: With different weather, the expedition would have taken place.

piezas.titulo: Если бы + past tense presents a condition that did not happen; то + бы expresses the hypothetical result.
texto: Если бы + past tense presents a condition that did not happen; то + бы expresses the hypothetical result.
то can be omitted, or бы can appear next to the verb of the result; the meaning remains counterfactual.

opciones.explicacion: Бы presents the event as possible in an imagined situation.
This form does not express the relation the question asks about.
Check which word governs the case or the structure.

pregunta.texto: What does this phrase mean? «Если бы редактор заметил ошибку, статью бы исправили раньше.»

frase.texto: Если бы редактор заметил ошибку, статью бы исправили раньше.

opciones.texto: If the editor had noticed the mistake, they would have corrected the article sooner.
opciones.explicacion: It corresponds to the first example.

opciones.texto: With different weather, the expedition would have taken place.
opciones.explicacion: That is the translation of the second example.

frase.texto: При другой погоде экспедиция состоялась бы

piezas.traduccion: With different weather, the expedition would have taken place.
piezas.explicacion: Pay attention to the order of the words and to the grammatical form highlighted.
